job.title: Technical Sales Representative
job.description:
About the Company
Our client is one of Australia's leading distributors of advanced automation, electrical and instrumentation solutions trusted by manufacturers, engineers and industry leaders nationally. Backed by some of the world's most sought-after product brands and a genuine role in building Australia's sovereign manufacturing and industrial capability, they're a business genuinely going somewhere.

About the Role
This is a rare opportunity to build something real in North Queensland. You'll be out in the field, representing genuinely leading automation, electrical and instrumentation solutions to manufacturers, contractors and industrial businesses across the region solving real engineering challenges, not just taking orders. Based from a real Townsville hub, with regular travel across the region and up to Cairns, you'll build your own patch with genuine autonomy backed by Internal Sales and another experienced Sales Rep, so you're never doing this alone. This is a role for someone who wants ownership over their own success, challenge in equal measure with support, and a business that's genuinely growing around them.

Duties
  • Build genuine relationships with North Queensland's manufacturers, contractors and industrial businesses
  • Represent a portfolio of world-class automation, electrical and instrumentation brands
  • Identify and shape solutions that solve real customer challenges, backed by our client's technical specialists
  • Own your own success on the road, manage your own patch and pipeline with genuine autonomy, backed by a real local team
Skills & Experience
  • A genuine relationship-builder with a consultative, curious approach to sales
  • Comfortable on the road, and driving your own success across a regional patch
  • Industry or technical exposure (automation, instrumentation, electrical, industrial) is a plus. Attitude and drive count just as much
  • Full driver's licence and Australian work rights
Culture & Team
You'll be based from a genuine Townsville hub backed by Internal Sales and another experienced Sales Rep, with technical specialists ready to help you win the bigger opportunities. This is a role for someone who wants to build something real, with genuine autonomy and genuine support in equal measure.

Benefits
  • $100,000–$120,000 + Super
  • Company car, phone and laptop
  • Structured onboarding with the wider team to set you up for success
  • Genuine autonomy + ownership over your own success, not micromanaged
  • An established, growing business backed by leading, in-demand product brands
How to Apply
Submit your resume using Quick Apply or contact the team at Giide.

job.title: Internal Sales Representative - Building Materials, Morningside
job.description:
About the Company

Ceilings by Design is one of Queensland's most established building materials suppliers, with more than 30 years supplying hospitals, schools, office and retail fit-outs across QLD. The Morningside team of around 25 works from a purpose-built facility designed to support the business's ongoing growth. It's a hardworking, no-nonsense team where leadership is accessible and performance is genuinely recognised.

About the Role

Join the internal sales team at Morningside and run the trade enquiry pipeline from first contact through to quote delivery. If you've got experience in construction, building materials or trade supply, or you're simply drawn to that world and want to build a career in it, this is a structured, supportive environment to do exactly that.

You'll work alongside an experienced external sales team, building product knowledge and customer relationships from day one. No tools required. No cold calls. Full training provided.

Duties
  • Manage inbound trade enquiries from builders, contractors, project managers and internal stakeholders
  • Prepare accurate project quotes and pricing using estimating software
  • Process sales orders and coordinate delivery schedules
  • Support external sales representatives with quote preparation and customer follow-up
  • Build and maintain relationships with repeat project clients, finding the right product solution for each job
Skills & Experience
  • Background in construction, building materials or trade supply preferred; genuine interest in the industry will also be considered, you understand or want to learn how builders and contractors work
  • Sharp attention to detail, quoting accuracy matters every time
  • Confident communicator, comfortable with walk-in and phone enquiries
  • A solutions mindset, you enjoy finding the right product fit for a customer's project, not just processing an order
  • Quick to pick up new systems and processes
  • Team-oriented, reliable, and happy in a varied, hands-on day
Benefits
  • $65,000-$75,000 base salary + Superannuation
  • Permanent, full-time, genuine job security and career stability from day one
  • Monday to Friday only, no nights, no weekends, no on-call
  • Free on-site parking at Morningside
  • Full structured onboarding, product training and mentoring provided
  • Stable, established customer base, warm inbound enquiries only, no cold calling
  • Supportive, varied team environment with leadership who work alongside you
  • Morningside, Brisbane
How to Apply

Click APPLY to submit your application.

Ceilings by Design is working exclusively with recruitment partner Giide for this permanent position. Full Australian work rights required.

job.title: Fabricator/ Assembly - Aluminium
job.description:
Brisbane Aluminium is one of Queensland's leading manufacturers and suppliers of aluminium partition systems, frames, doors and windows — supplying commercial construction and fit-out projects across South East Queensland.
We're expanding the production team and have multiple permanent positions available now.

What's on offer
  • $60,000–$70,000 + superannuation — based on experience
  • Permanent full-time — not labour hire, not casual
  • Monday to Friday, 6:00am–3:00pm — no nights, no weekends
  • 4 weeks annual leave + personal leave entitlements
  • Regular team events and genuine staff recognition
  • Staff training and development
  • Free parking — Morningside facility

The facility
In 2025, Brisbane Aluminium completed a full expert layout and fitout of the Morningside facility designed with workflow efficiency and accessibility front of mind. Every workstation, storage area, and production line has been positioned to reduce unnecessary movement, keep the floor clear, and make the job easier from the moment you start.

The work
You'll be working in a structured production environment assembling and fabricating aluminium frames, doors, windows and partition systems for commercial projects across Brisbane.

Day-to-day:
  • Fabricating and assembling aluminium frames, doors, windows and partition components
  • Reading and working from technical drawings and cut lists
  • Using hand and power tools accurately and safely
  • Maintaining quality standards across all finished products
  • Preparing and staging finished products for dispatch
  • Supporting the team across the production floor as required
Who we're looking forWe're building a team for the long term. We're not looking for a specific trade ticket — we're looking for people who work hard, take pride in the product, and show up consistently.
You'll be a good fit if you have:
  • Experience in a production, assembly, manufacturing, or trade environment
  • Comfortable with hand and power tools — aluminium or other materials
  • Able to read basic drawings or a willingness to learn
  • A safety-first approach and a positive attitude
  • Physically capable of lifting up to 25kg and working on your feet
New to aluminium? That's fine. If you've worked in construction, trade assistance, joinery, glazing, steel fabrication, shopfitting, or any hands-on production role the fundamentals transfer. We'll back the right person with on-the-job training. Forklift licence is a bonus but not required.

The culture This is a workplace that invests in its people not just the work. The team is close-knit and the business puts genuine effort into making it a place people want to be. Regular team events, meaningful staff recognition, and leadership that actually notices the effort you put in.
The stability Permanent employment from day one. Consistent hours, reliable workflow, and a business with 30+ years supplying major Brisbane construction projects. This is not project-based work or labour hire. It's a real job with real job security.

Apply now — multiple roles available, interviewing this week.

Call 1300 160 867 or submit your resume. All applications treated with confidentiality.
Giide is recruiting these roles on behalf of Brisbane Aluminium. Permanent positions only. Full working rights in Australia required.
